newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says Cambior to take La Granja option.
newsitem.headline: Peru says Cambior to take La Granja option.

text.p: Peru's privatization body COPRI said Friday that Canada's Cambior Inc had decided to exercise its option to develop the La Granja copper project.
"It's a fact. They are going to sign on Monday," a COPRI spokesman told Reuters.
A COPRI statement said Cambior, which has invested $25 million exploring the site, now planned to plough a further $450 million into the project.
"The investment to come will be no less than $450 million," the statement said.
COPRI said La Granja, located in the Cajamarca department some 400 miles (640 kms) north of Lima, had reserves of 1.2 billion tonnes of mineral with 0.68 percent copper.
"This has turned into a mega-project," the statement said.
The firm acquired a five-year option on 100 percent of the property from state-run Minero Peru S.A. in March 1994, promising to spend $25 million on exploration.
La Granja was billed originally as a copper-gold site but does not have enough gold to mine economically, officials have said.
